the signed data-check-string.

SessionResponse.description:
Returned by every login and by ``GET /auth/session``.

``csrf_token`` must be kept in memory by the client and sent as ``X-CSRF-Token`` on every
state-changing request. The session token itself is only ever in the HTTP-only cookie.

get.description: All orders (optionally one status), newest first.

patch.description:
Move an order one step forward, or cancel it (``reason`` required; stock is returned).

Send ``expected_status`` (the status you saw) to get ``409 order_status_conflict`` instead of
overwriting a colleague's change.

post.description:
Delete the session (if any) and expire the cookie. Idempotent.

When a live session is presented, ``X-CSRF-Token`` must match it, so a cross-site request
cannot sign the user out.

get.description: Active categories as a tree. An inactive category hides its whole subtree.

post.description:
Re-check the cart (status, current price, stock) and price delivery for a district.

Never fails because of the cart's contents: problems are reported in ``issues`` and
``can_place_order``. ``409 district_not_served`` when no active zone covers the district.

get.description:
Active zones with their districts, fees, minimum order and Asia/Tashkent hours.

``is_open_now`` is as of the response; it may be up to a minute stale from a cache.
Liveness: the process is up. Touches no dependency.
Readiness: the database answers ``SELECT 1``. Failures are logged, never returned.

post.description:
``retry`` backs off exponentially and gives up (``failed``) after 8 attempts.

Send the ``attempts`` value from the claim as ``attempt``. 404 when the message is unknown,
already finished, its lease expired, or it was reclaimed since (a newer ``attempt``).
Upsert the user the bot is acting for. The body id must equal the signed actor.
